what_happened: The ego was going straight in its lane and braking from 17 to 9 m/s, so the lead car (actor 18) pulled away, from 12.7 m to 36 m ahead. Then, between 6.6 s and 7.1 s, actor 18 jumped from about 36 m ahead to overlapping the ego (gap 1.4 m), which looks like a glitch or ID swap in the replayed actor track, not real motion, and this registered as a front collision.

The ego stayed in its highway lane but slowed from about 17 to 9.4 m/s with no close lead, ending up about 12 m behind where the human car was at that moment. At 7.1 s, actor 18 (tracked earlier as the lead about 36 m ahead) shows up overlapping the ego's front-right as a car merging in from the right lane. That looks like a replayed actor, or a track-ID jump, moving into space the human car had already left; the ego never steered into it.

After handoff, the ego braked steadily on a straight highway (17.1 to 8.8 m/s) while lead actor 18 pulled away to 36 m. Then within half a second actor 18 jumped onto the ego's position, overlapping its front-right (gap 36.2 to 1.5 m). That is physically impossible, so it looks like a replay or tracking teleport of the logged actor, probably made worse by the ego sitting about 13 m behind where the recorded car was.

After handoff, the ego braked hard on an open highway lane (17 to 8 m/s, with nothing within about 59 m ahead at 6.6 s). It also drifted about 0.8 m left of the recorded path. At 7.1 s a vehicle coming up from behind (id 28) ran into the ego's right-front side and rear while still driving at its recorded speed. The impact was counted as an at-fault front collision, but the ego was hit by an actor that did not react to it.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT command, the policy steered left out of its lane, away from the recorded path, while speeding up from 4.5 to 6.8 m/s. Its front hit vehicle 56, which was driving in the adjacent left lane just ahead and beside it. A trailing actor also touched the ego's rear, but only after the front collision began.

Following the RIGHT command in dense, slow highway traffic, the ego edged right into the lane of actor 15, a slower car just ahead and to its right. The gap fell from 28 m to 10.6 m once 15 counted as the car ahead, then shrank to 4.7 m, but the ego only slowed from 6.7 to 6.0 m/s and hit 15 with its front.

The ego kept to its lane and sped up gently from 4.5 to 6.8 m/s while the recorded human drifted left. Replayed actor 56, in the lane to the left and slightly ahead, moved right across the lane line into the ego's path, and the ego's front-left clipped it (the gap to the actor ahead fell from 21.8 m to 3.6 m). The ego was also struck from behind at some point in the run.

On a multi-lane highway with a STRAIGHT/RIGHT command, the policy planned and started an unprompted lane change to the left while speeding up from 4.2 to 6.7 m/s. Its front then hit actor 56, which was travelling in the adjacent left lane just ahead; the recorded human drive stayed in its lane.

The ego stayed in its lane on a multi-lane road and sped up from 4.2 to 6.8 m/s, while the recorded human path drifted left. Actor 56 came up from behind on the left, passed the ego and cut right into the ego's lane just ahead of it, and the ego's front corner clipped 56 at 7.2 s (the gap to the actor ahead fell from 21.8 m to 3.6 m). Separately, something also hit the ego's rear.
